Local copies of hebcal libraries, used by /limudim/olami/ (daily learning cycles: Daf Yomi, Rambam, Mishna Yomit, 929...).
Downloaded unmodified from jsdelivr "+esm" bundles on 2026-11-08; only import paths were rewritten to local files.

- @hebcal/hdate 0.23.1     - GPL-2.0-or-later - https://github.com/hebcal/hdate
- quick-lru 7.3.0          - MIT             - https://github.com/sindresorhus/quick-lru

Source code for each library is available at the links above and on npm.
